description: Retrieves variables published from a specified Figma file; this API is available only to full members of Enterprise organizations.

inputSchema.description: Defines the request parameters for retrieving published variables from a Figma file.

file_key.description: The key of the Figma file from which to retrieve published variables. This must be a main file's key, not a branch key, as publishing from branches is not supported.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: GetPublishedVariablesRequest

name: get_published_variables

GetPublishedVariablesResponse.description: Defines the structure of the response when successfully retrieving published variables.

data.description: The structured response data containing status, error information, and the metadata of published variables.
data.title: Data

GetPublishedVariablesResponse.title: GetPublishedVariablesResponse

PublishedVariable.description: Represents a published variable in a Figma file library.

id.description: The unique identifier of this variable, stable within the file where it is created.
id.title: Id

key.description: The stable, unique key of this variable, generated by Figma upon creation.
key.title: Key

name.description: The user-defined name of this variable.
name.title: Name

resolvedType.description: The resolved data type of the variable, such as `BOOLEAN`, `FLOAT`, `STRING`, or `COLOR`.
resolvedType.title: Resolved Type

subscribed_id.description: The ID used by subscribing files to reference this variable. This ID changes each time the variable is modified and republished.
subscribed_id.title: Subscribed Id

updatedAt.description: The UTC ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this variable was last modified and published.
updatedAt.title: Updated At

variableCollectionId.description: The identifier of the variable collection to which this variable belongs.
variableCollectionId.title: Variable Collection Id

PublishedVariable.title: PublishedVariable

PublishedVariableCollection.description: Represents a published variable collection in a Figma file library.

id.description: The unique identifier of this variable collection, stable within the file where it is created.
id.title: Id

key.description: The stable, unique key of this variable collection, generated by Figma upon creation.
key.title: Key

name.description: The user-defined name of this variable collection.
name.title: Name

subscribed_id.description: The ID used by subscribing files to reference this variable collection. This ID changes each time the collection (or any variable within it) is modified and republished.
subscribed_id.title: Subscribed Id

updatedAt.description: The UTC ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this variable collection was last published. This timestamp updates if any variable within the collection is modified and subsequently published.
updatedAt.title: Updated At

PublishedVariableCollection.title: PublishedVariableCollection

PublishedVariablesData.description: The top-level data structure returned by the get published variables endpoint.

error.description: Boolean flag indicating if an error occurred with the request. For successful operations, this value is `false`.
error.title: Error

meta.description: Contains the core data of the response, including dictionaries of published variables and variable collections.
meta.title: Meta

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response. For this operation, a successful response is indicated by status 200.
status.title: Status

PublishedVariablesData.title: PublishedVariablesData

PublishedVariablesMeta.description: Contains the published variables and variable collections from a Figma library file.

variableCollections.description: A dictionary where keys are variable collection IDs (strings) and values are the corresponding detailed variable collection objects.
variableCollections.title: Variable Collections

variables.description: A dictionary where keys are variable IDs (strings) and values are the corresponding detailed variable objects.
variables.title: Variables

PublishedVariablesMeta.title: PublishedVariablesMeta

ResolvedType.description: Enumeration of possible resolved data types for a Figma variable.
ResolvedType.title: ResolvedType
